theme: Dark/Light Toggle (Archetype 5: Jewel & Luxury - Premium, Cinematic, Calm)

typography.rules: DO NOT use Inter or Roboto for headings. Pair a classic Serif for book titles with a clean geometric Sans for the UI.

headings.fontFamily: Playfair Display, serif (Fallback to System Serif)
headings.usage: Book Titles, Screen Headers, Empty State Headers

body.usage: UI labels, player controls, settings, paragraphs, sentence text

layout_and_spacing.card_radius: rounded-2xl (16px) or rounded-3xl (24px) for premium feel
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align text wherever possible. Never center paragraphs or long lists of sentences.

bottom_navigation.style: Solid background matching 'surface' color with 1px top border matching 'border' color. Padding bottom for safe area.

mini_player.style: Floating absolute above bottom nav. Surface background, shadow-lg, rounded-xl. Contains mini cover, title, play/pause.
mini_player.layout: Row based, flex-row, items-center. Left-aligned text.

full_player.hero_image: Top section. Book cover with large rounded corners. Do NOT apply heavy dark overlays that ruin the image.
full_player.text_scroller: Middle section. Left-aligned sentences. The active spoken sentence receives 'highlight_sentence' background + primary text color for high contrast.
full_player.controls: Bottom section. Large elegant play button (64px). Skip buttons (-/+ 1, 5, 10 sentences) arranged cleanly. Length scale slider uses a thin track.

library_grid.style: 2 columns (gap-4). Cover aspect ratio 2:3. Book title below cover, 1 line truncate. No generic borders, let the cover stand out.

library_list.style: Horizontal row. Small 64x96 cover. Title and meta information on the right. Left-aligned.

forms_and_modals.style: Use Shadcn-like primitives but translated to React Native. Large touch targets (min 44px height). Action sheets for context menus.

empty_states.description: Empty minimal bookshelf for empty library/folder view

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building an Expo React Native app using .js files.
Do NOT use placeholder text or services like via.placeholder.com. Rely entirely on the provided image_urls.
Apply the styling using React Native StyleSheet or NativeWind (if installed). The spacing scale reflects Tailwind logic (e.g., p-6 = padding: 24).
UI strings MUST be entirely in Italian: 'Libreria' (Library), 'Riproduci' (Player/Play), 'Cartelle' (Folders), 'Carica' (Upload), 'Impostazioni' (Settings).

Sentence highlight feature: When reading, standard text should be 'text_secondary', active text should be 'text_primary' + bold + highlighted background. Left-align the reading text for proper literary feel.
Do NOT use standard purple/teal gradients. Stick to the 'Jewel & Luxury' natural elegant colors.
Test IDs are MANDATORY for all interactive and key informational elements (e.g., testID='play-pause-button', testID='library-grid-toggle').
